text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (December 9, 2025) for 640 Lauder Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (December 9, 2025) for 640 Lauder Avenue, Folder No. 25 264337 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 31, 2026.
